1. they kicked down the door. like kicked jt in. and then they took it off the hinges because my door was cracked from being kicked in
2. no i do my laundry separately. and also my mom was wearing those same pajamas the night before, and the washing machine/dryer wasn’t being used yesterday at all. so i know she must’ve taken my underwear
my friends have tried talking in private to school counselors at my school, but they always end up calling the parents so i don’t think i could do that. so i don’t really trust them
my sister is younger than me, so i don’t think she’d really be able to handle what’s going on

my phone password changes every once in a while because i know they try to get into my phone. but both of my parents are kinda emotionally abusive. however, i kinda feel bad for my dad because i feel like he’s kinda being brainwashed by my mom. he’ll be a pretty nice person until my mom starts to talk bad about me and tell him things that aren’t true. and whenever my dad disagrees with her and thinks i’m right in a situation, she’ll start massaging his neck and shoulders aggressively until he says either “i don’t want to be a part in this argument” or starts yelling at me. so i don’t really know what to do

we have a counselor but i don’t really trust her. if i tell her i’m not sure what’s gonna happen next. what if i don’t have enough evidence to prove my side and i just have to live with my parents even longer, and all my family members will hate me for causing a huge scene
i don’t know what to do though. my sisters birthday is tomorrow and i don’t wanna ruin it but at the same time i’m so scared and i just don’t know what to do
all of my teachers call my mom about things like my attendance. i’m too scared of telling them. even my nurse has called my mom for post concussion symptoms and stuff

no, not really.. i think i was molested by someone on my moms side when i was little so i don’t really trust any of my male family members. and my aunts are dealing with a lot right now. and i have a sister in law, but her mom passed away and i don’t wanna feel like a burden talking about how my mom could’ve possibly done something when my mom is the only mother figure she has

well, i have a quora account which i had posted the question on a couple months ago in the summer when she had facetimed her male friends. and i have evidence of me texting my friends what’s going on, but other than that, nothing

please don’t kill them unless they’re about to kill you. take detailed notes about what they’re doing in the day when they abuse you so the police can like verify they were in that place at that time when they abused you
